notes: Clicking a player's name now opens their leaderboard profile with region, server and class pre-filled. Toggle Gear Score / Combat Power directly in fight history. Players who belong to a legion/guild no longer disappear from the meter. Summoner (Spiritmaster) pet damage and cleric effect & DOT damage are now credited to the right player instead of being merged into another same-class member, in both the meter and the saved/uploaded record. Also fixes the fight-history party composition (no more phantom extra players) and fills the leaderboard server reliably from the party list.
